component.name: Motionwall
component.summary: Use a video as your desktop wallpaper

description.p: Motionwall plays any video file (MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV, GIF) as an animated desktop background on GNOME. On Wayland a bundled GNOME Shell extension draws the video in the desktop's own background layer, behind every window and the desktop icons; on Xorg a small daemon does the same with desktop-layer windows.

Video is decoded on the GPU, and playback pauses automatically whenever nobody would see it: screen locked, user idle, on battery, or a full-screen application in front. A settings window manages a library of videos, scaling, speed, sound and the power-saving rules; a command line and D-Bus API are included.
